# Al Sahra Tents & Sheds
> Based in Sharjah, Al Sahra Tents & Sheds designs, manufactures, and installs tensile shades, custom tents, and steel structures across the UAE.

## Key Facts
- Primary Phone: +971 50 507 7179
- Email: info@alsahratents.ae
- Location: Sharjah, UAE (https://share.google/vAOTAMUzTnEZ14Z7X)
- Services: Tensile shade structures, car parking shades, customized majlis tents, structural steel sheds, sail shades, retractable bioclimatic pergolas, aluminum CNC mashrabiya.
- Core Material Offerings: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE), Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC), Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE).
- Expertise: Over a decade of experience with local UAE building codes, material engineering, and structural design standards.

- [Services - Tensile Shades](https://www.alsahratents.ae/services/tensile-shade-structures): Engineering and fabrication of tensile membranes.
